text_ar:
و حَدَّثَنِي عَنْ مَالِك
أَنَّهُ رَأَى رَبِيعَةَ بْنَ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ يَقْلِسُ مِرَارًا وَهُوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَلَا يَنْصَرِفُ وَلَا يَتَوَضَّأُ حَتَّى يُصَلِّيَ
text_ar_search:
و حدثني عن مالك
أنه رأى ربيعة بن أبي عبد الرحمن يقلس مرارا وهو في المسجد فلا ينصرف ولا يتوضأ حتى يصلي
text_en:
Yahya related to me from Malik that he saw Rabia ibn Abd ar-
Rahman vomit several times when he was in the mosque and he did not
leave, nor did he do wudu before he prayed.


Yahya said that
Malik was asked whether a man who vomited food had to do wudu and he
said, "He does not have to do wudu, but he should rinse the inside of
his mouth and wash his mouth out."
text_id: Perawi menerangkan; telah menceritakan kepadaku dari Malik, bahwa dia melihat [Rabi'ah bin Abu Abdurrahman] muntah berulang kali ketika sedang berada di dalam masjid, tetapi dia tidak beranjak keluar dan tidak berwudlu sampai dia melaksanakan shalat.
